method: Pollen CADR saturates in the certified data: many models report the same top value, so ranking by it would pick an arbitrary subset. We kept every zero-ozone ENERGY STAR air purifier at that top pollen CADR (450 cfm or more) and ranked the 10 with the highest dust CADR, weighing dust CADR and the five-year electricity cost (certified yearly energy use x current EIA U.S. average residential price x 5).
name: Best air purifiers for allergies: top certified pollen CADR, ranked by dust CADR and running cost
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100
